description: Smoke-test subset for the SafeVerify->Comparator migration, DISPROOF path: 5 OEIS conjectures whose correct answer is a disproof -- each was disproved and accepted in every one of the 15 historical result runs (all models), so they are robustly false with the shortest published disproofs, giving a strong model a real chance to reproduce the disproof and exercise the Comparator accept path for claim=disproof end to end. Not a benchmark subset.
